small_block_orientation.notice: Only visible geometry is matched; powered and hidden properties are not recoverable

geometry_state_inference.policy: Geometry-aware; abstain when family or orientation is ambiguous

stair_orientation_refinement.policy: signed 8x8 tread/riser topology, globally calibrated winding; abstain on ties

fence_geometry_inference.policy: only wood plank families with characteristic post faces on both axes and a clear model winner

slab_half_refinement.policy: only reassign slab half on a strong signed Y=0.5 surface; abstain otherwise

notes: Mesh surfaces do not reveal hidden blocks or exact original block states.
Atlas override mappings include visually inferred block species and always require review.
Fractional surfaces are assigned to parent voxels, but block shapes/states require additional inference.
Bedrock 1.26.0 writer compatibility requires client verification.
